entries.en: My dad...? He's, uh, just over there!
Oh, wow! Are you a... BD star?
entries.ro: Oh, wow! Ești... star de BD?

entries.en: My dad is cool… He gave me some Leelou Beans… Yeah…! We played "Kings of Acid."
entries.ro: Tata e mișto… Mi-a dat niște Leelou Beans… Da…! Am jucat „Kings of Acid”.

entries.en: Can I come back tomorrow…? Awww! Don't wanna wait that long…! You promised we would play again…! But…
entries.ro: Pot să vin iar mâine…? Awww! Nu vreau să aștept atâta…! Ai promis că mai jucăm…! Dar…

entries.en: My friends will never believe me!
entries.ro: Prietenii mei nu mă vor crede niciodată!

entries.en: Uh… Y-you're not gonna shoot, right?
entries.ro: Uh… N-nu o să tragi, nu-i așa?

entries.en: Do you think I'm just a kid? Like, I won't notice you?
entries.ro: Crezi că sunt doar un copil? Adică, n-o să observ?

entries.en: Uh, are you gonna kidnap me?
